issue.subject: Record as-built implementation status per acceptance criterion
issue.description:
**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

Code already exists on branch `origin/feat-remote-resolve-automation-latest` (and related repositories) and has not been validated against the agreed ACs. For each AC (RT-NOC-AUTO-AC01 to AC50 on Stories S1-S11, #22949-#22959) record one status as a note on its Story: Not started, Built (unvalidated), Built (validated), or Built (differs from AC).

Differences already known (2026-11-19): (a) usage step: the engine config matches is_usage_over_gb false first, so exactly 1 GB and missing usage (error 2008) go to NOC; the agreed order is over 1 GB to Remote Resolve, else false with error to the error route (Manual Check), else false to NOC, with a strict under-1-GB check; (b) the Engine 2 diagram is to be updated to show this order (Dev acknowledged); (c) the RT BCS webhook handles succeeded, failed and unconfirmed only and rejects succeeded_new_channel, succeeded_same_channel and skipped from Peppermint v1.2.0-rc.1; (d) the Node-RED error route (onu_error_event: NOC, In Progress, error-message comment) matches the decision for job errors and needs no change; (e) the report contract on the branch maps more statuses to Manual Check than the PRD defines (open in PRD section 9); (f) the RT BCS webhook and result sweeper recognise only succeeded, failed and unconfirmed, so a Peppermint rc.1 success or skipped is rejected (webhook) or recorded as failed after the give-up time (sweeper) until the status handling is updated.

**Done when:** every Story has a status per AC and every difference is listed on the Story or turned into a Bug or AC change through review.
